parsed.rationale_overall: System B provides deeper personalization by tying recommendations to specific profile attributes (loss comfort, occupation, income, experience level) and offers more structured rationales with explicit trade-offs. While System A has cleaner factual grounding (real tickers vs. B's placeholder tickers like VANGUARD_529 and 401K) and slightly more concrete first-step actions, B's overall analytical depth and profile-causal reasoning give it the edge across most criteria.
